notes: §1985:XIV.2.2.4 GR9: during RECEIVE the MCS provides in data-name-6 “the time at which it recognized that the message was complete in the form 'HHMMSSTT'”, updated only by RECEIVE. CommunicationArea#SetReceived, called only from MessageControlSession#Transfer, writes positions 55-62 (input) or 7-14 (I-O) from StoredMessage#Complete's HHmmss plus hundredths at the EMI or EGI that completed the message. Probes at --std 85: seeded time 23595999 on every portion; an in-run message's time 22565387 equal to ACCEPT FROM TIME; NO DATA, a status-20 RECEIVE, ACCEPT MESSAGE COUNT, an I-O SEND, PURGE and DISABLE left it unchanged; the I-O RECEIVE after ENABLE set 01020304. The witness checks RECEIVE against ACCEPT, DISABLE and ENABLE.

next.reason: 1985: the MCS stores in data-name-6 of the communication description entry 'the time at which it recognized that the message was complete in the form HHMMSSTT', updated only by RECEIVE. 2023 has no communication section or communication description entry; its RECEIVE statement 'receives a message from a server run unit' through a message-tag data item and a length data item (§2023:14.9.31.4 GR1) and sets no message-completion time. No 2023 rule carries the requirement.
